title: gateway OpenAI-compatible models listing: list_models maps named gateway endpoints to OpenAI model objects with the endpoint name as id
answers: Why does client.models.list() return gateway endpoint names instead of provider model names?
Why are some gateway endpoints missing from the OpenAI models response?
What timestamp format does the gateway models response use for created?
body:
Path: `GET /gateway/mlflow/v1/models` is handled by `mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:list_models`, which reads gateway endpoints from the store via `store.list_gateway_endpoints()` and returns the OpenAI list payload defined in `mlflow/gateway/schemas/models.py:ResponsePayload` and `ModelObject`.
Rule: Each returned model's `id` is the gateway endpoint name, which is the value callers pass as `model` to `/gateway/mlflow/v1/chat/completions`. Endpoints without a name are skipped, and the rest are sorted by name. `created` is the endpoint's `created_at` converted from milliseconds to seconds (`// 1000`), and `owned_by` is the constant `"mlflow"`.
Constraints: The schema extends `ResponseModel` from `mlflow/gateway/base_models`. The route is served from the gateway router, so it returns 501 with the gateway-disabled message when the gateway is turned off (covered by `tests/server/test_gateway_disable.py`). Authorization is not in this handler; see the related gateway model listing auth note.
Applies: Changes to the gateway OpenAI-compatible models listing or to its response shape, and to the mapping from gateway endpoints to model IDs.
applies: The gateway OpenAI-compatible models listing response: its ids, ordering, created field and schema.
says: The model picker shows gateway endpoint names instead of the underlying provider model names.
Unnamed gateway endpoints are missing from the list of available models.
Sort the available gateway models alphabetically by name in the model list.
Model creation dates in the gateway listing appear with incorrect second-based timestamps.
Listing gateway models returns a service disabled error when the gateway feature is off.
search: The OpenAI-compatible model listing route `GET /gateway/mlflow/v1/models` is handled by `mlflow.server.gateway_api:list_models`, mapping endpoints from `store.list_gateway_endpoints()` to `mlflow.gateway.schemas.models.ResponsePayload` and `ModelObject`. Each model object sets `id` to the endpoint name, sets `owned_by` to `"mlflow"`, converts `created_at` from milliseconds to seconds (`// 1000`), skips unnamed endpoints, and sorts results by name. The route schema extends `ResponseModel` from `mlflow.gateway.base_models` and returns a 501 gateway-disabled error when the gateway is disabled. This handler does not perform authorization checks and applies to changes in gateway OpenAI-compatible model listing responses, response shapes, and endpoint ID mappings.
